body.p: At one time there was a young woman or girl who lived. with her parents. She was very fond of playing with the bones of seal-flippers,[[See p. 112.]] which she made to represent people and animals. One evening when her father and mother were asleep and she was playing alone, the Moon came down to her on a sled, and called her by name: u Tootocuttuke, Tootocuttuke, come live with me and bring your games with you!" She could not resist, and put on her clothing, sat down on the sled, and went with the Moon and became his wife.[[See No. 8, p. 173.]]
